answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds agent identities to a cryptographic stake burning curve: minting identity n requires burning an exponential cost C(n) = C_0 * 2^n in native stake, imposing superlinear attacker cost. A validation grove prunes duplicated identities, an audit falcon tracks cross-cluster collateral flows, and any protocol echo of duplicate behavioral signatures triggers immediate, unrecoverable slashing.
